videos.script: Every class so far lived in a package with no name. Real programs have hundreds of classes, and two of them called Date is a certainty. {{packages}} A package gives a class a full name, and that name is also a path on disk. Get the two out of step and you meet two different errors. {{imports}} Then imports. An import loads nothing. It only tells the compiler what a short name means, and when two packages both have a Date, you have to choose. {{maven}} Then Maven, which builds a project from one file, the pom. This lesson fixes the layout that every project in this course uses, and the two courses after it. The first build downloads a hundred and fifty pieces of Maven. Every build after that downloads nothing. {{jar}} Last, a jar that runs on its own, and a build that fails because Maven found the wrong Java. By the end you can lay out a project the way most Java teams do, build it, and read what the build printed.
